chapter_title: Concerning the Five Releases: what they are
spiritual_reading:
The first unbinding and preservation is the liberation of the primal good that engages directly with evil. For when Divine truth in living operation descended to it and broke the domination of falsity and evil over it, much wisdom and much strength were reclaimed from the whole organized tyranny of the lower powers. These reclaimed goods and truths were raised with that primal good into the higher degrees of life and into the greater state of the Divine. This is the first release.

The second preservation is that effected by Divine truth in living operation itself. For when the inmost Divine good together with the Divine wisdom-principle brought forth the ordered framework of the spiritual degrees and their outward extensions, and set each level in its place with the subordinate governing forces proper to each, immeasurable wisdom was drawn out from those lower dominations that had seized and consumed what belonged to the primal good, and that wisdom was gathered up and withheld from further profanation. Much in this portion is unclear because the text is broken, but the movement is of reclaimed light being taken back from the perverted order that had devoured it.

What follows speaks of successive conflicts in the spiritual world, completed through a full series of struggles, until the victorious ordering power was established in a higher degree above the rebellious forces and above the whole arrangement of the created system. The details are uncertain because of the gaps, but the sense is of combats of truth against falsity until a stable government from above is set.

The third redemption is that of the mediating Divine influence that proceeds after the first ordering. By making Divine quality visible in a form accommodated to those who were in lower states, it confronted the organized ruling falsity, drew away what could be rescued from their grasp, and re-established it in a new reception. Thus the restoring work was carried forward by an accommodated manifestation of the Divine through that mediating descent.

The fourth preservation is that of Divine truth as revealed in glory. For when it was made manifest in the intermediate region between higher and lower states, it presented the Divine quality openly before the fixed outer structures of the heavens, and it purified the wisdom that remained above from admixture with falsity. It instituted the first form of genuine justice in that domain. It took on an accommodated appearance, making itself like the heavenly affections and their thoughts, until it could go on and descend even to the ultimate natural state, where truth is clothed in the lowest form. It then arranged and stabilized all lower domains and their fixed connections, restored what had been bound, and released measureless wisdom throughout the whole ordered structure. It issued a directed influx that compelled responsiveness in the most external knowledges and forces, and it brought forth a new operative form of truth for instruction and renewal. After this it rose again and came to rest in the state of pure wisdom and peace.

The fifth release and preservation is that of the great inward deliberation of Divine providence, which is the directed influx and the responsive reception. By it the living human mind is also drawn upward from the higher state, so that what is to be ordered below may be ordered according to what is above; this line is partly uncertain because of the broken wording, but it describes the same operation of call and answer by which ascent and restoration are effected.

What follows again invokes Divine truth in living operation as the giver of release. It indicates successive stages: first, an ascent and a strengthening through enlightened understanding; then further dispositions of wisdom in ordered forms; and finally, an entering into the ultimate recipient, where the whole is set in order so that a final formed receptacle can bear an image of Divine wisdom and goodness in the last and lowest degree. Some of this section resists full translation because key words are missing, but the drift is that the prior salvations are gathered into a final ultimate formation capable of holding the Divine image.

These five great operative powers were made manifest. They were brought into effective use and established in their proper foundations, so that the primal good, after its combat and return from struggle, could order and build the whole system as a coherent universe. In this way the entire arrangement stands together with its powers fixed in their functions, and the restoring descent is secured.

The closing fragment attributes this stability to the wisdom that had been rescued and set in motion through the mediating descent; because of the gaps, the precise linkage is uncertain, but it affirms that the reclaimed light presses onward from the Divine intervention and becomes the means by which the whole is sustained.

fills.notes: The Living Spirit’s descent is not devotional but functional: an ordering power ‘comes’ to draw out and raise light. In the oldest register this is consistently described as coming ‘to the rescue’ or ‘for the release’ of the First Man, i.e., for the extraction of light from the rulers’ prison.

What the Father of Life and Mother of Life ‘constructed’ in the substrate is the graded framework: aeons (inner degrees) and firmaments (outer fixed boundaries). This matches the spiritual sense: ordered framework of degrees and outward extensions.
The sequence demands a connective: ‘and worlds … worlds, the earths…’. The cosmological list is being resumed, not introduced anew.

The saving ‘from them’ is the recovery of light that had been seized in connection with the First Man’s mixture. The sentence needs a phrase linking the rescued light to him, as in the spiritual translation.

fills.fill: and his light was gathered up
fills.notes: After ‘devoured’ the expected oldest-layer movement is not moral lament but extraction: the devoured light is separated, collected, and withheld from further mixture. This supplies the missing predicate for the broken clause ‘lig[ht …]’.
The fragment speaks of a series brought to completion. In the substrate, wars are ‘completed’ when the ordering power has fixed the bounds above the rebels.
Bridges from ‘three wars’ to a terminal time clause: ‘after three wars … to the time when…’.
The spiritual sense requires the victorious power being ‘established’ above them; ‘set himself’ (i.e., took his station) matches the cosmological idiom.
The close reads ‘upon the … universe’; ‘the whole universe’ is the required object in this register, marking totality of the ordered system.
The paragraph is an explanatory ‘since when’ clause, paralleling ¶2-3 (‘since when …’). The Third Ambassador’s action is not exhortation but manifestation and separation.

The Third Ambassador ‘displays his image’ as an accommodated manifestation in intermediate regions (‘zones’) to confront the rulers, matching the spiritual translation’s ‘form accommodated to those in lower states’.
Standard cosmogonic formula: the image is displayed ‘before’ the ruling power for judgment and separation.

fills.fill: and he drew out the light
fills.notes: The Third Ambassador’s function in the oldest layer is extraction by manifested form: drawing out what can be rescued from the rulers’ grasp.
What is drawn out is not merely removed but set in a higher placement, i.e., re-established in a new reception above the rulers.
The summary sentence points back to the operative act: the displayed image is the means of the rescue.
The image is said to ‘be’ or ‘stand’ in the Third Ambassador; ‘is established’ keeps the impersonal, structural tone.

Jesus the Splendour ‘establishes the first righteous one’ as a stable form of right order in the intermediate domain (‘in the midst’), matching the spiritual sense: first form of genuine justice instituted there.
He takes a likeness ‘of the powers’—the celestial beings/forces—before becoming like angels and then descending to flesh; this preserves the graded descent logic.
He ‘made himself like the angels in …’ naturally takes ‘in the firmaments’ (the fixed outer structures) already mentioned earlier in the paragraph.

fills.fill: ed the bonds, and he released
fills.notes: After ‘fastenings’ the oldest-layer move is loosening bonds and releasing light. This matches the spiritual translation’s ‘restored what had been bound, and released measureless wisdom’.
The great counsel (summons and obedience) functions as the call-and-response by which what is lower is raised into order; hence it ‘draws up’ the soul in a non-devotional, mechanical sense.
A resumptive marker fits: after the five savings are listed, the text returns to invoke the Living Spirit’s giving of release in stages.
Links ‘the Living Spirit’ to the manner clause ‘as he gave…’.
Keeps the additive logic: the Living Spirit is invoked again ‘also’ as giver of release beyond earlier mention.
The release is distributed by degree: each power receives its proper operation. This matches the spiritual translation’s ‘successive stages’ gathered into ultimate formation.
The numbered sequence begins (‘The first…’). A causal/temporal hinge ‘since when’ matches earlier style and introduces the ascent action.
Spiritual sense: ascent and strengthening through enlightened understanding; thus the first stage includes being ‘strengthened’.
He ‘received … wisdom’ is the needed verb for the fragment ‘as he … wisdom …’.

fills.fill: and he set it in order
fills.notes: The sequence moves from reception of wisdom to ordering forms, matching the translation’s ‘further dispositions of wisdom in ordered forms’.

fills.fill: in the structures of the firmaments.
fills.notes: Wisdom is disposed into ‘structures’ at the level of firmaments (fixed ultimates of a heaven). This aligns with the text’s focus on firmaments, fastenings, and ordered framework.
Bridges to ‘The fourth … its wisdom …’: a fourth stage that ‘establishes’ wisdom in a fixed form.
The fourth stage commonly involves fixing and sealing boundaries (a correspondential ‘firming’). ‘Sealed’ suits the impersonal cosmic ordering.
The final clause: entering the ultimate recipient so that it ‘bears’ the light-image in the Last Statue. This gives the needed teleology.
Defines the ‘five great powers’ by their operation: they are manifested ‘in the five releases’, matching the chapter’s structure.
In the substrate these are operative agents (not moral teachers). ‘Saviours’ here means deliverers of light by function; it pairs naturally with ‘releases’.
Connective needed: ‘They came to a profit … they were established…’.
They are ‘established upon’ something; ‘their foundations’ keeps the architectural-cosmic register.
Introduces the purpose clause: establishment enables the First Man’s ordering of the universe.
Before ‘universe’ the expected quantifier is ‘the whole’, matching earlier totalizing idiom.
Completes ‘First M[an ...] his advent’: ‘First Man, at his advent’ is the natural phrase for the moment of return and ordering after struggle.
The clause ‘they stand with …’ requires the companions: the established powers standing together in the ordered system.
The point is stability-by-order: each power fixed ‘in their places’, matching the spiritual translation’s ‘fixed in their functions’.

The light ‘rushed from … the Ambassador’ points to the mediating descent. In this chapter’s sequence the mediating figure tied to the Ambassador’s work is Jesus the Splendour as revealed in the zone; naming him here keeps the causal chain of released light pressing onward.

assessment: Most mid-word lacunae are mechanically secure. Larger gaps in ¶3–¶5 and ¶8 are only moderately constrained: the correspondential narrative requires a fixed sequence of (1) descent for rescue, (2) construction of aeons firmaments worlds and extraction of devoured light, (3) successive wars ending in establishment above the rebels, (4) Third Ambassador’s accommodated image drawing out light, (5) Jesus the Splendour’s descent to ultimates and release of measureless light, and (6) a staged ordering culminating in the Last Statue. Exact phrasing for the broken stage-list in ¶8 and the war-summary in ¶4 remains tentative, but the restorations preserve the oldest-layer, impersonal cosmological register and the inside-to-outside logic of ordering and fixation.
